meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page, terminal, and paginated-document surfaces. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift, PDF page check, deck review, blank or near-empty page, wrong page break.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页、终端和文档的视觉效果,标出异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完页面都担心显示效果
copy.tagline_en: Verify UI visuals on web, terminal, and documents via screenshot diffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change UI often and worry about visual regressions.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会检查你做的界面（网页、终端界面或 PDF 等），先截图并用脚本对比差异，再派两个审查员分别检查设计系统是否真实、文字是否有中日韩文截断等问题，最后给出整体通过或不通过的结论。
howto.when: 在构建或修改任何界面之后，或当你询问页面、组件、终端界面看起来是否正确时触发；也常用于检查截图差异、界面显示异常、中日韩文字截断等视觉问题。

say.text: 我刚改完这个网页，帮我做视觉检查。
say.note: 他会截图对比并给出通过/不通过。

say.text: 对照这张设计稿，看我的页面还原得怎么样？
say.note: 会对比参考图和实际截图。

say.text: 检查这个终端界面有没有文字截断或错位。
say.note: 会检查 CJK 宽字符和边框对齐。

howto.what_en: Runs visual QA on web, terminal, and paginated surfaces: captures screenshots/TUI evidence with diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then gives a good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Also used for screenshot/pixel diff, wrong-looking UI, CJK clipping, and similar.

say_en.text: I just changed this web page; please run a visual check.
say_en.note: It captures screenshots, compares, and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Compare this design mock against my page.
Check this terminal UI for text clipping or misalignment.
say_en.note: Checks CJK wide chars and border alignment.
